verdict.rationale: TrueLayer's Data API documents reading balances from a user's connected bank account, so the core capability of fetching a connected account's balance exists. The evidence does not show it is real-time, positioned as a pre-payment step, or intended for NSF/risk checks. Merchant account balances in Console (docs-20) cover the merchant's own account, not the payer's, and are not credited. Missing for 10: documented real-time freshness of the balance, explicit pre-payment NSF/risk-check use case, endpoint-level reference detail, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fetch a real-time balance for a connected account before initiating a payment — a documented balance endpoint intended for NSF and risk checks

citations.quote: Read account information, balances and transaction history from a user's bank.
